levels: Does it go through several screens toward one goal?
Does it own a whole screen, its own URL?
the sign-in page, settings, a dashboard
Does it stay put while the screens inside it change?
Is it a full-width band on a site page?
Otherwise it sits in a slot on a screen.
the sign-in box, a button, a chart
Is it a style applied to anything, or a collection?

flow.why: several screens in order, toward one goal; seen as a strip of screens you click through

account.job: first run: set up, invite, tour

work.job: make a new thing in steps
bring data in: upload, map, check

page.why: owns a whole screen (a URL); seen full size, desktop and mobile

screens.job: numbers and lists at a glance
the screen around the sign-in box
a list beside the open item
any other whole page or template

shell.why: frames the whole app; seen in a device frame at one size, desktop and mobile, swiped side by side

app-frame.job: the app's main nav down the side
the app's bar across the top
a row of apps or tools
the phone's tab bar along the bottom
sidebar plus top bar plus content
a page's title row with its actions

part.why: sits in a slot inside a screen; seen in a card, at its own size

actions.job: a bar of tools or filters
a toggle with a count: like, star, upvote
pick one of a few, inline

inputs.job: typed values with a format: phone, money, card
name a field, help or error under it

forms.job: the sign-in or sign-up box itself
shows which step you are on

display.job: a boxed note: tip, warning, answer
boxes and lines: a map, a flow, a mind map
comments and threads on a thing
a month or week of events

overlays.job: a list of actions from a button

widgets.job: one dashboard card: grip, title, figures, door, states
the grid of widgets: sizes, drag, presets
pick widgets to add, with live thumbnails

section.why: a full-width band of a page; seen full width, desktop and mobile

set.why: not parts: what parts are made of or move with
